s1.syndrome_frame: A vascularized iris mass with ciliary body involvement and anterior chamber angle involvement
salient_findings: 10 × 9 × 3.5-mm, well-delineated, bilobed, vascularized, tan, peripheral iris nodule
key_facts: Patient is a man in his late 60s
Presented for evaluation of a right iris lesion
Visual acuity was 20/25 OU
The eye was pseudophakic
Slitlamp examination showed a vascularized iris nodule
Ultrasonographic biomicroscopy showed ciliary body involvement
Fine-needle aspiration biopsy results showed a monomorphic population of small to medium-sized hyperchromatic lymphocytes
CD20+ lymphocytes were present
Few CD3+, reactive T lymphocytes were present
Systemic evaluation showed no other involvement
Staging was T2N0M0

shortlist.label: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: CD20+ lymphocytes and monomorphic population of small to medium-sized hyperchromatic lymphocytes

shortlist.label: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Vascularized iris mass with ciliary body involvement and anterior chamber angle involvement

shortlist.label: Primary uveal lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Iris lesion with ciliary body involvement and no systemic involvement

shortlist.label: Lymphoma of the iris
shortlist.why_kept: Monomorphic population of small to medium-sized hyperchromatic lymphocytes and CD20+ lymphocytes

shortlist.label: Vitreoretinal lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Iris lesion with ciliary body involvement and possibility of vitreoretinal involvement

raw.rationale: The presence of a vascularized iris nodule, ciliary body involvement, and a monomorphic population of small to medium-sized hyperchromatic CD20+ lymphocytes on fine-needle aspiration biopsy results are consistent with lymphoma of the iris.

rejected.label: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: While CD20+ lymphocytes are present, the description does not specifically indicate a diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.

rejected.label: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma
rejected.why: The specific type of lymphoma is not clearly indicated by the provided information.

rejected.label: Primary uveal lymphoma
rejected.why: The uvea includes the iris, ciliary body, and choroid, but the primary focus here is on the iris.

rejected.label: Vitreoretinal lymphoma
rejected.why: The description focuses on an iris lesion and does not indicate involvement of the vitreous or retina.
